ALTER VIEW [DW].[FactLoansOutstandingBalance_View]
	AS 

WITH FactLoansOutstandingBalance_Latest AS (
SELECT
max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance as FDL
)

Select LNS.*
from DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance as LNS
    INNER JOIN FactLoansOutstandingBalance_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.BusinessDateSK = LNS.BusinessDateSK
